errors.description: Cannot verify the bias grain sits on the INNER cuff. The cuff is shown unbuttoned and splayed open, and the large panel turned toward the camera on an opened cuff is normally the OUTER face; that camera-facing panel is the one carrying the diagonal stripe. The drawing hatches the inner face only and leaves the outer face plain.
errors.expected: diagonal (bias) grain confined to the inner cuff facing; outer cuff face and sleeve both straight grain
errors.actual: diagonal grain on the camera-facing cuff panel (most plausibly the outer face); a second panel (the rounded button end) runs near-horizontal; only the sleeve is unambiguously straight
errors.correction: Shoot the cuff folded outward on itself so the inside surface is unambiguously the one facing the lens, with the outer face visible alongside it running straight grain for contrast.

More than one cuff panel is off the straight grain, so the drawing's single-panel isolation does not read.

errors.actual: camera-facing panel diagonal plus button end near-horizontal

notes: Attempt 3 of 3. Attempts 1 and 2 (by an earlier worker) both put the diagonal squarely on the closed outer cuff face, which is unambiguously wrong for this option.
